frequency.description: Log rotation frequency (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, or custom interval like 'daily' or 'weekly')

rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep

create.description: Whether to create new (empty) log files after rotation

dateext.description: Whether to use date extension (e.g., .20230401) for rotated files

compress.description: Whether to compress rotated log files
